Asked परशु- राम not to enter शिव's abode as he was with उमा. When he forced entry, विनायक made him wander all the seven worlds. परशुराम knocked his teeth with his axe to the enragement of पार्वती. शिव thought of कृष्ण who appeared on the scene with राधा. कृष्ण said that विनायक should be remembered on all auspicious and other occasions to bring out the desired results. The शैव Gan2es4a became वैष्णव:
4: Ib. III. ४१. १७-32, ch. ४२, ४४. २३.
wor- shipped in all ceremonials as preliminary, in the भीष्म dva1- दशि, in grahabali;
5: M. ५८. २६. ६९. २७; ९३. १६.
when उमा made out of earth an elephant- faced doll and threw it in the Ganges, it became a huge figure, adopted as son both by उमा and गन्गा; came to be known as गान्गेय and गजानन; invested with overlord- ship of all विनायकस्.
6: Ib. १५४. ५०५; २३०. 8.

--a prince of Avanti, a son of राजाधिदेवी and brother of Anuvinda;
1: वा. ९६. १५७; Vi. IV. १४. ४३.
under the influence of Duryodhana (as also Anuvinda) the brothers wanted to give their sister in marriage to Duryodhana, and not to कृष्ण whom she loved: stationed by जरासन्ध at the southern gate of मथुरा and Gomanta during their respective sieges.
2: भा. X. ५८. ३०; ५०. ११[3]; ५२. ११[9]; Br. III. ७१. १५८.
--sacred to राधा. M. १३. ३८.

--the tribes of the Vindhya region. Br. III. ७४. १८६; M. ११४. ५१ and ५४.
--(च्) a northern kingdom. Br. II. १६. ४८.
and (मर्दन)--is Agastya. Br. IV. १०. ७६; ३२. २८ and ४८.

--one of the sixteen शक्तिस् of ललिता. Br. IV. ३५. ९९.

--the queen of Bali, who participated in his gift to वामन. Seeing Bali bound with cords, she appealed to Hari;
1: भा. VIII. २०. १७; २२. १९-20.
mother-in-law of अनौपम्या wife of बाण; had a daughter called कुम्भीनसी; both of them ill-treated बाण's wife.
2: M. १८७. ४०.
--a son of Indrasena and father of twins by मेनका. M. ५०. 6-7.
